summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads has reached a significant milestone with an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion, enhancing access to AI through both free and affordable options. Meanwhile, Tokenless, a Y Combinator startup, offers automatic model switching to optimize costs for users, and Fund Momentum MCP provides real-time data on venture capital funds for AI agents, aiding informed investment decisions. Google DeepMind's Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash update enhances developer control and customization in application building. Additionally, Microsoft Research's Skala 1.1 improves predictive density functional theory tools for computational chemistry, while the Open ASR Leaderboard's inclusion of a language from the Global South marks progress in diverse language recognition in AI.
recommendations: Focus on the most impactful advancements in AI and technology, such as revenue milestones and significant product updates.
Highlight the implications of new tools and research developments for users and developers in the AI community.
Consider removing items that do not provide new insights or are less relevant to the current trends in AI.

items.original: The Open ASR Leaderboard Adds Its First Global South Language
items.rewritten: The Open ASR Leaderboard has introduced its first language from the Global South. This addition marks a significant step in recognizing and incorporating diverse languages into automatic speech recognition systems.

items.original: Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT. Skala 1.1, the updated deep-learning exchange-correlation functional from Microsoft Research, provides greater accuracy, expanded accessibility across the computational chemistry ecosystem, and a living benchmark to track computational performance. The post Broadening access to Skala creates a faster path to predictive DFT appeared first on Microsoft Research .
items.rewritten: Microsoft Research has released Skala 1.1, an updated deep-learning tool that enhances predictive density functional theory (DFT). This version offers improved accuracy and wider accessibility for users in computational chemistry, along with a benchmark to monitor computational performance.

items.original: 3 new ways to plan and book travel in Search. Book hotels and track airfares, plus view miles and rewards with AI Mode in Google Search.
items.rewritten: Google Search introduces three new features for planning and booking travel. Users can now book hotels, track airfare prices, and view their miles and rewards, all enhanced by AI capabilities.

items.original: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash lets you build with more control
items.rewritten: Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash provides developers with enhanced control for their projects. This update allows for more flexibility and customization in building applications, improving the overall development experience.

items.original: Fund Momentum MCP: Live VC Fund Data for AI Agents
items.rewritten: Fund Momentum MCP provides real-time data on venture capital funds specifically for AI agents. This tool enables users to access live information, enhancing their ability to make informed investment decisions in the AI sector.

items.original: Launch HN: Tokenless (YC S26) – Automatic model switching to save money
items.rewritten: Tokenless, a startup from Y Combinator's Summer 2026 batch, offers automatic model switching to help users save money. This feature allows for seamless transitions between different models based on usage, optimizing costs without sacrificing performance.

items.original: A milestone in expanding access to AI. ChatGPT Ads reaches $1 billion in annualized revenue run rate and expands globally, supporting broader access to AI through free and affordable options.
items.rewritten: ChatGPT Ads has achieved a significant milestone, reaching an annualized revenue run rate of $1 billion. This expansion supports broader access to AI, offering both free and affordable options to users worldwide.

items.original: Show HN: Diffusion PDF – A Diffusion Image Model Embedded Entirely in a PDF File
items.rewritten: Diffusion PDF is a tool that allows users to create images using a diffusion model, all contained within a PDF file. This means you can generate and view images without needing additional software. It's a convenient way to share and showcase diffusion-generated artwork.

items.original: Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite for Home Assistant
items.rewritten: The Aquila Voice Assistant Test Suite is a set of tools designed for testing voice assistant functionalities within the Home Assistant platform. It helps developers ensure that their voice commands and interactions work smoothly. This suite is useful for improving the overall user experience with voice-controlled home automation.

items.original: Show HN: Alyph, a manual transmission for LLM context
items.rewritten: Alyph is a tool designed to help users manage the context of large language models (LLMs) more effectively. It acts like a manual transmission, allowing users to control how the model processes information. This can enhance the interaction with LLMs by providing more tailored responses.

dropped.original: Show HN: Draco – A single-binary, self-hostable Firecrawl alternative in Rust
dropped.rewritten: Draco is a self-hostable alternative to Firecrawl that is packaged as a single binary written in Rust. This makes it easy to deploy and manage without needing extensive setup. It offers similar functionalities to Firecrawl, providing users with a lightweight option for web crawling.
